notes: Trimmed verbose text on the Tuning and Labware screens for a cleaner look. Device detection broadened to legacy USB-serial chips (CP210x, FTDI, Prolific, CH34x/CH9102, MCP2200, Exar, STM VCP) and native/legacy hardware RS232 COM ports, so the Tip Charger / display auto-connects over any converter; the connect check still requires a real data stream.
